title: desktop.uia.invoke (request, Brain -> Body) payload
description: Press one element of an allowlisted app (amendment 19) through UI Automation: Invoke, Toggle or SelectionItem pattern, never the mouse. An element whose name or automation id looks destructive or outbound needs confirm_id: a confirmation this Body saw approved for exactly this action (amendment 20).

element.description: Which element: name (case-insensitive, exact) and/or automation_id (exact); control_type narrows it. Exactly one element must match.
